seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2029–30 | Key Dates
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2029–30 calendar, including the August 8 first day, May 23 last day, school breaks, Friday delayed starts, and the official PDF.
heroSourceLine: 2029–30 calendar dates · Based on official DCSD calendar sources
verificationBadgeText: Checked against official DCSD calendar sources on August 6, 2026.
schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Douglas County School District dates for 2029–30, including conventional-calendar school breaks, no-school days, PLC delayed-start days, and district holidays.
heroSummary:
Douglas County School District students begin the 2029–30 school year on Wednesday, August 8, 2029, and the last student day is Thursday, May 23, 2030. The conventional calendar includes 173 student days. Fall Break is October 8–12, Thanksgiving Break is November 19–23, the winter student closure runs December 24 through January 4, and Spring Break is March 18–22. January 7 is a teacher work day, and students begin the second semester on January 8.

DCSD also uses Friday delayed starts during the 2029–30 school year. District-operated elementary and middle schools begin 45 minutes later; see the full PLC schedule below.
calendarNotes: This page covers DCSD’s conventional academic calendar. Most DCSD schools follow the conventional calendar, but Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars. PLC Fridays are regular attendance days with a 45-minute delayed start for DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools; high schools continue their existing Friday schedule, and buses run 45 minutes later. Check your school for exact times.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2028–29
content: The first student day moves from August 9 in 2028–29 to August 8 in 2029–30.
Fall Break shifts from October 9–13 in 2028–29 to October 8–12 in 2029–30.
The winter student closure shifts from December 25–January 5 in 2028–29 to December 24–January 4 in 2029–30.
Spring Break shifts from March 19–23 in 2028–29 to March 18–22 in 2029–30.
The last student day moves from May 24 in 2028–29 to May 23 in 2029–30.

customSections.label: DCSD Friday Delayed Starts
customSections.content: During the 2029–30 school year, DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools continue to start 45 minutes later every Friday for Professional Learning Community time. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules, and school buses also run 45 minutes later. Check your school for its exact bell time and before-school care arrangements. Charter schools may follow different schedules.

table.footnote: Dates were transcribed from the PLC markers in DCSD’s official color calendar PDF. The color calendar shows Friday, November 30; the list-view calendar incorrectly labels Thursday, November 29 as a PLC Friday. Check your school for its exact Friday bell schedule.

customSections.label: Calendar Exceptions
customSections.content: Most DCSD schools follow this conventional calendar. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish their own calendars. Families at those schools should confirm dates directly with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school in DCSD for 2029–30?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 8, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day of the DCSD conventional calendar is Thursday, May 23, 2030. May 24 is a teacher work day with no students.

calendarFaqs.q: When are fall, winter, and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 8–12, 2029; the winter student closure is December 24, 2029–January 4, 2030; and Spring Break is March 18–22, 2030.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a PLC delayed-start day?
calendarFaqs.a: Students still attend school on PLC Fridays, but DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools start 45 minutes later and buses run 45 minutes later. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules; check your school for its exact bell time.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: DCSD’s conventional calendar lists 173 student days for 2029–30.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every DCSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against DCSD’s academic calendars page, color calendar, list-view calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and Professional Learning Communities guidance. The 2028–29 calendar was also reviewed for the year-over-year comparison.
sourceReviewDetails: For the fourth November PLC date, the color calendar marks Friday, November 30, 2029. The list-view calendar incorrectly prints Thursday, November 29 as a PLC Friday, while Calendar at a Glance omits the fourth November PLC date. This page uses November 30 because it matches the color-calendar marker and the Friday schedule.

Calendar at a Glance repeats March–June 2029 dates inside its 2029–30 section. This page does not import those copied dates; March–June 2030 dates were checked against the color and list-view calendars instead.

We compared the major breaks and no-school dates across DCSD’s calendar landing page, color calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and list-view calendar. Where official sources use different wording or dates, we state the discrepancy and the source used.
DCSD’s Professional Learning Communities guidance explains the 45-minute elementary and middle school delay and later bus schedules; families should confirm exact bell times with their school.
Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.
